Welcome to Bookzangle

Quick Search

Bookzangle is an international group of booksellers who believe that quality of books and quality of service far outweigh simple quantity of listings.

Our Customer Guarantees are agreed to by all booksellers listing at Bookzangle. You can search or browse our listings with perfect confidence, knowing that the items offered are as described and will be shipped to you promptly upon your order, carefully and professionally packaged.

Search or browse our listings

Our selling members offer a wide range of listings which our Advanced Search Page allows you to quickly locate.

Our site is arranged carefully into a number of Virtual Bookshelves (Categories) so you can browse our categorised shelves as you would in an "Bricks & Mortar" shop. Enjoy!

For Book Lovers

Lots of interesting and useful links to other important sites for both book buyers and booksellers: bibliographies; other selling sites; book binders; bookselling and book buying blogs; bookseller supplies and a whole lot more.

Free database for Selling Members

When you join Bookzangle as a bookseller you get access to our seller database. You will be amazed at its fluency and power.

Selling tools for Selling Members

Booksellers who join Bookzangle enjoy a wide range of software utilities and tools which can significantly improve and enhance their listings and sales at all their other selling sites. These cover both their book listings and their picture uploads to all sites.

Join our Seller Community

Booksellers worldwide: come join the Bookzangle party! Provided your listings are honest and careful ones, you are most welcome to join us here. You can then offer all your books for sale on our site and, in addition, take advantage of our many multi-site bookseller software tools and utilities.
